name: Agent Meaning Agreement (AMA) 0.3.0-research
description: Agent Meaning Agreement (AMA) 0.3.0-research provides two exact deterministic evaluation profiles (finite latency statistics and Unicode/UTF-8 text length), Python and JavaScript reference implementations, a bounded volatile Go peer, lifecycle regression tests, and a selected local experiment with the official A2A Python SDK. Project initiative and direction: Mohammed Messaoudene. Implementation, testing, analysis and drafting used disclosed AI assistance. This attribution does not assert manual human authorship of every line, exclusive rights in all AI-generated material, or independent institutional validation. The measured conclusion for the finite preconfigured workload is SIMPLIFY_TO_PROFILE: a complete explicit contract and a conditional active-revision registry meet the selected requirements with fewer setup exchanges. The full offer/accept state machine remains a research comparator for historical receipts and explicit acceptance. Distribution of the preconfigured manifest and human configuration effort were not measured. The attached ZIP is the exact 114-file public candidate approved for release. Recorded candidate checks: 106 core test methods PASS; Go build/test/vet PASS; 47 ordered lifecycle steps across Python, JavaScript and volatile Go; 52 local A2A checks across 17 exchanges; bounded B0/B1/AMA comparison reproduced. Counts describe distinct, overlapping campaigns and are not independent validation totals.
